title: Agent model picker
responsibility: Presents models grouped by provider and updates both identifiers of the chosen agent model.

inputs.name: AgentModelPicker.providers
inputs.description: Required array of ProviderState entries, rendered in array order with each provider's label, its reason line when reason is set, and its models; the picker does not read version or imageGeneration. Unavailable providers stay visible with disabled model buttons, an available provider with no models shows 'No models listed.', and an empty array shows 'No agent provider available.'

examples.label: Codex CLI
examples.reason: Sign in to Codex CLI with a ChatGPT subscription.

inputs.name: AgentModelPicker.provider
inputs.description: Required bindable ProviderId, either 'codex' or 'claude', naming the chosen provider; a model click stores the clicked provider section's id here unchanged. Together with model, it sets the active class and aria-pressed=true on the matching button, and the title passed to ChoiceDialog is 'Model: <provider label> · <model label>' when both match a listed choice, otherwise 'Choose model'.

inputs.name: AgentModelPicker.model
inputs.description: Required bindable model identifier, matched by id against the listed models of the chosen provider and never defaulted by the picker. A model click stores the clicked model's id unchanged here and calls the close() argument of the children snippet; a value that matches no listed model leaves no button active and gives the title 'Choose model'.

outputs.name: AgentModelPicker
outputs.description: Markup for a ChoiceDialog labelled 'Choose model' with the model icon and one section per provider, each showing its label, its reason when set, and a button per model; the current choice gets the active class and aria-pressed=true, buttons of unavailable providers are disabled, and the messages 'No models listed.' and 'No agent provider available.' appear where they apply. An enabled model button sets provider and model together, then calls close().
